children.value: > Fact From Story: Swift confirmed that when she first attended Kelce’s game at Arrowhead Stadium in September, she was already dating the NFL star.
> Fact From Story: Taylor Swift said she connected with Kelce in July.

> > Fact From Story: Swift said she connected with Kelce after he confessed on his podcast that he tried to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it during one of her Eras Tour shows.
> > > Fact From Story: Kelce revealed that he made a friendship bracelet with his number on it to give to her, seemingly expressing his interest in Swift.
> > > Fact From Story: Travis Kelce announced that he went to Swift's concert, but said he did not have the chance to meet her.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People express romantic interest to people they want to connect with.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People connect after one person expresses romantic interest.
> Commonsense Knowledge: July is before September.
